definitions.explanation: Short for セルフサービス. Marks a service the customer performs themselves — pumping gas, pouring water, carrying a tray, scanning purchases. Used almost entirely in compounds and on signs.

examples.japanese: お{水|みず}はセルフです。
セルフのガソリンスタンドは{値段|ねだん}が{安|やす}い。
{最近|さいきん}はスーパーのセルフレジが{増|ふ}えて、{並|なら}ぶ{時間|じかん}が{短|みじか}くなった。
examples.english: Self-checkout machines have increased at supermarkets recently, and the wait in line has gotten shorter.

notes:
Frequently seen on shop signage as a single word: セルフ (self-service) versus {フル|ふる}サービス (full service).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セルフサービス: self-service
- セルフレジ: self-checkout register
- セルフのガソリンスタンド: a self-service gas station
- セルフでどうぞ: please help yourself
- セルフケア: self-care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自分|じぶん}で: by oneself — the plain Japanese way to say the same thing in speech
- {無人|むじん}: unstaffed — emphasizes that no employee is present at all
- {自動|じどう}: automatic — the machine does it, rather than the customer
